map.转矩 τ = Kt · I（Kt 为转矩常数 N·m/A、I 为电流 A）；例: Torque τ = Kt · I (Kt the torque constant in N·m/A, I current in A); example Kt = 0.05, I = 10 A → 0.5 N·m
map.τ=Kt·I 是理想电磁转矩，未计入铁损、机械损耗、温升去磁、驱动器限流与减速箱: τ=Kt·I is the ideal electromagnetic torque and excludes iron loss, mechanical loss, thermal demagnetization, drive current limiting and gearbox efficiency. Usable shaft torque is usually lower, so leave margin in selection.
